why: What one point of each System stat does, as data. Why data: how strong a point is, and which attribute carries it, are balance decisions that will change, and one of them (Tensura's magicule pool) exists only when Tensura is installed. Each effect names an attribute by registry id, how the modifier combines (add_value, add_multiplied_base or add_multiplied_total), how much ONE point adds, and a ceiling on the total (cap, 0 = none). The game applies every effect as a permanent attribute modifier with the fixed id nusmp:system/<stat> and silently skips an attribute that is not registered. The per-stat limit on points is the server config system.maxStatPoints (30), so the caps below are what the best build can reach: 30 points of STR add 6 attack damage, of AGI 25 percent speed, of VIT 10 hearts, of INT 60 percent more magicule, of SENSE 5 luck and 24 blocks of presence sense.
